source_extracts.label: FedEx Schedule a Pickup (official)
source_extracts.quote: You don't have to be present for a FedEx pickup. But be sure to leave your package somewhere safe and accessible to the driver. Look for a FedEx door tag that confirms pickup and provides tracking information. If the driver determines your package can't be picked up, the door tag will explain why and tell you what to do next.

source_extracts.label: FedEx Schedule a Pickup — on-call timing
source_extracts.quote: Expedited service: pickups for expedited shipments can be scheduled for same day or next day pickup. Standard and economy services: schedule pickups for standard or economy shipments the next business day or up to 10 business days in advance.

source_extracts.label: FedEx Schedule a Pickup — drop off free
source_extracts.quote: Don't want to wait for a pickup? Drop off your packages at a retail location for free.

source_extracts.label: FedEx Schedule a Pickup — guest scheduling
source_extracts.quote: Already have a prepaid shipping label? You can schedule a pickup through our guest pickup scheduling without an account.

source_extracts.label: FedEx Schedule a Pickup — pickup pricing change
source_extracts.quote: Effective August 18, 2025, FedEx will begin using a new pricing and rating structure to charge for parcel pickups.

source_extracts.label: FedEx Delivery Manager / door tag FAQ
source_extracts.quote: Follow the directions on the door tag to verify that your package is available for pickup. When you arrive at the location listed on the door tag, provide a government-issued photo ID and your tracking number to pick up your package.

source_extracts.label: FedEx Delivery Manager — hold duration
source_extracts.quote: Your package will be held at the indicated location for 5 business days, after which time it may be returned to the shipper.

source_extracts.label: FedEx Hold at Location — hold duration
source_extracts.quote: FedEx will hold your package for up to 7 days. After that, we'll return it to the shipper.

source_extracts.label: FedEx Hold at Location — pickup ID requirements
source_extracts.quote: You'll need your tracking number, government-issued photo ID, and your door tag number.
